caption:
Save this before you fill a single form 📌

Your IIM route map for 2027. Every exam is a line, every IIM is a stop:

🟣 IPMAT Indore: IIM Indore, Ranchi, Amritsar, Shillong, Sirmaur, Sambalpur and IIFT
🟢 JIPMAT: IIM Jammu and IIM Bodh Gaya
🟠 IPMAT Rohtak: IIM Rohtak
🔵 IIM B UGAT: IIM Bangalore
🔴 Own tests: IIM Kozhikode, IIM Bangalore (DBE) and IIM Udaipur

IPMAT Indore 2027 is on Saturday, 24 April 2027 (afternoon shift). Rohtak and JIPMAT dates are not out yet.

Which line are you on? Tell us in the comments 👇
Send this to the friend who keeps asking "which exam for which IIM?"

#IPMAT #IPMAT2027 #JIPMAT #IIMBUGAT #IPMCareers
